label: 2.00ct E VVS2 — second comparison, relatively lively
commentary: Second stone in the same 2.00ct E VVS2 video pair (#1), measuring 7.23 × 7.01 mm with reported depth 65.3%, table 60% and crown 14.5% / 31.5°. Ibrakeforpossums preferred its livelier relative movement over the first (#2), and the buyer independently chose it as the favourite (#3), before reporting it sold (#5). This is not a stand-alone declaration of ideal optical performance or a causal claim about its proportions. The two stones have no established certificates.

source_links.note: Shared original comparison video; R15 is the SECOND stone.
